networks.name: dawai_saathi
networks.description: Find the cheaper Jan Aushadhi generic for the medicines your doctor wrote, in Bengali, Hindi or English, and see your monthly saving.
sample_queries: Doctor wrote Pan-D and Telma 40. Is there a cheaper one?
আমার মা Glycomet GP 1 আর Ecosprin 75 খান। সস্তা কোনটা?
मेरे पापा Rosuvas 10 और Amlong 5 लेते हैं, सस्ता विकल्प?

llm_router.note: Bring your own key. A free Google AI Studio (Gemini) key works: router https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai, model gemini-3.5-flash-lite. OpenAI or OpenRouter keys also work.

peer_policy.note: Only the Jan Aushadhi Price Desk may be contacted, after the user approves.

agent_mcp.reason: Static site: no public MCP facade. Call this network as a peer agent network instead (it runs in your browser).
